rows.name: caption/Layers · expanded
rows.text: Seventeen rows, each with an eye and a lock — the same two controls corrected on 143:179 and 143:237. The eye only writes data-hidden on the canvas node (useLayerActions.ts:140-146); the element still publishes. The lock also writes ElementData.locked, so it travels with the document while the panel re-reads only localStorage. UX-H-14, UX-H-17.

rows.name: caption/Layers · display-settings
rows.text: The popover draws four options; LayerDisplaySettings.tsx ships three — Show HTML tags (div, section, h1…), Show element IDs (#abc123 format), Compact rows. Show hidden layers, Show lock badges and Highlight CMS-bound do not exist in LayerDisplayPrefs (types.ts:60-67), and the real title is Display Settings.
